_doc: Generated by library/tools/export_visuals.luau from the pure Visuals modules; do not edit by hand. Search this file for an existing preset before writing any effect. Each entry has id, name, category, description, params, quality and a usage line. Kinds: vfx, ui, object, camera, pet (Core/Registry presets), rarity (Rewards profiles), feedback (events of the built-in packs), audio (cue names; no sounds are bundled), theme, component (UI/Game), and screen when the Screens module is present.

component.description: Achievement card: a round icon, title, description, tier stars and a progress bar. Locked achievements are dimmed. When `unlocked` turns true the card flashes gold with a shine and the earned stars pop in one by one.
component.name: AchievementCard

component.description: Corner badges: sale and bonus pills, the red circular "!" attention badge, NEW and the tilted BEST ribbon. Parent it to the object it decorates; it anchors to that object's corner.
component.name: Badge

component.description: Chunky gradient button with outline, gloss, optional shine sweep, icon and price.
component.name: CartoonButton

component.description: HUD currency counter: outlined pill with a big currency icon overlapping its left end, the amount, and an optional green "+" button that runs `action` (for example "OpenPanel:Shop"). Value changes count up with the "count" preset (duration and easing) on the shared ticker and pop the icon; under reduced motion the number changes at once.
component.name: CurrencyCounter

component.description: Cartoon dropdown: a gradient button showing the value and an arrow; activating it opens a list of outlined option buttons under it. Choosing one closes the list and fires Changed / onChanged. With a gamepad the first option is selected when the list opens.
component.name: Dropdown

component.description: Chunky cartoon text with a UIStroke outline.
component.name: GameText

component.description: Shop-style window: white patterned body with a thick outline, a red header bar with a chunky outlined title, a red rounded X close button and a scrolling content area.
component.name: GameWindow

component.description: Responsive card grid: a UIGridLayout whose column count follows the breakpoint (Core/Breakpoints, read from UrkUI's responsive service when running, else from the camera and input devices). Cell widths are scale-based, so the grid stays correct under any UIScale; a UIAspectRatioConstraint on the layout keeps the cell shape. The grid grows vertically (AutomaticSize Y) for scrolling.
component.name: Grid

component.description: Hotbar slot: an ability icon with a keybind label and a cooldown shown as a dark shade that drains from the top down, with the seconds left on top. When the cooldown ends the slot flashes and bounces to say it is ready.
component.name: HotbarSlot

component.description: Square or round HUD rail button: big icon, optional outlined caption under it, optional badge.
component.name: IconButton

component.description: Inventory slot: a square inset tile with an item icon, a stack count, an outline in the item's rarity colour and three states: selected (raised, glowing outline), equipped (green tick) and locked (dimmed with a padlock; pressing it shakes and does not fire Activated).
component.name: InventorySlot

component.description: Leaderboard row: rank (a gold, silver or bronze medal for the top three, a plain number below), an avatar slot, the player's name and a value. The local player's row is highlighted.
component.name: LeaderboardRow

component.description: "Lvl. 3  [=====    ] 40/100": an outlined level label next to a game ProgressBar.
component.name: LevelBar

component.description: Loading screen: a full-screen cover with a breathing logo, a title, a progress bar and tips that rotate every few seconds. `screen:finish()` fills the bar, fades the whole screen out, fires Closed and destroys it.
component.name: LoadingScreen

component.description: Modal dialog: a dim backdrop that swallows clicks, and a window with a title, body text, an optional row of buttons and a content area. Opens with "ModalIn" over "BackdropIn" and closes with "ModalOut" / "BackdropOut".
component.name: Modal

component.description: Notification toast: a card with an icon, a title, a line of text and a thin bar that runs down until the toast dismisses itself. It drops in with "ToastIn", leaves with "ToastOut", then fires Closed and destroys itself. Clicking it dismisses it early (and fires Activated).
component.name: Notification

component.description: Rounded gradient container with a thick outline, optional checker pattern, gloss and drop shadow. The base of every other game component.
component.name: Panel

component.description: Pet card: a portrait slot, the pet's name, a rarity badge, a row of stat chips and an equipped tick. It grows on hover and shows a glowing outline when selected.
component.name: PetCard

component.description: Premium call-to-action button: gradient surface with gloss, a shine that sweeps across every few seconds, a breathing outline glow, and the "Premium" press feel (smooth spring, shine on hover).
component.name: PremiumButton

component.description: Colour-coded shop card: gradient panel with checker pattern and gloss, big icon, outlined title, optional "+50% Bonus" subtitle, price tag, corner badge, gift button and rarity outline.
component.name: ProductCard

component.description: Chunky progress bar: dark outlined track, gradient fill in a palette, optional "value/max" text and segment dividers. Value changes tween the fill (cancelled on destroy) and pulse the bar with the "progress" preset. This is the game-style version; Components/ProgressBar stays the themed one.
component.name: ProgressBar

component.description: The wide "STARTER PACK" offer: patterned gradient banner, big icon on the left, outlined title, subtitle, optional countdown, price tag on the right and a corner badge.
component.name: PromoBanner

component.description: Client bridge from the "Purchase" intent to Roblox's purchase prompts. It never grants anything: granting happens on the server (Systems/Shop: ProcessReceipt for developer products, ownership checks for game passes).
component.name: PurchaseBridge

component.description: Quest card: title, description, a progress bar, reward chips and a claim button whose state follows the quest: "active" (button greyed, shows progress), "claimable" (green button that breathes, the card flashes once when it becomes claimable) and "claimed" (done).
component.name: QuestCard

component.description: Rarity pill: the rarity's colour as a glossy gradient with its name in outlined capitals. High rarities (legendary, mythic, secret) shimmer with a looping shine; "secret" also cycles its outline through the rainbow.
component.name: RarityBadge

component.description: Outline in the rarity's colour. "secret" (rainbow = true in the style) cycles a rainbow through the shared ticker; under reduced motion it stays on one colour.
component.name: RarityFrame

component.description: Reward panel: a titled panel with a grid of reward tiles and a claim button. `panel:reveal()` pops the tiles in one after another from the centre out, then brings the claim button in and lets it breathe until pressed. Claiming fires Claimed (and Activated) once.
component.name: RewardPanel

component.description: Reward reveal: a patterned card that springs in with the "reveal" preset over slowly turning light rays, with a big icon, an outlined title and an amount. It closes itself after `duration` seconds or when clicked, then fires Closed (and destroys itself unless destroyOnClose = false).
component.name: RewardPopup

component.description: Section heading with a thick rounded divider line, like the separators between shop groups.
component.name: Section

component.description: Selection card: a large selectable card with a preview slot, a title, a description and a tick that shows when it is selected. The base of class, map, pet-team and game-mode pickers.
component.name: SelectionCard

component.description: Chunky slider: dark outlined track, gradient fill, white outlined knob. Drag with mouse or touch; with a gamepad, select it and press D-pad left / right (bound only while it is selected).
component.name: Slider

component.description: Stat chip: a compact pill with an icon and a value ("x2.5", "+15%", 1250). When the value changes the chip pops; a numeric value also rolls to the new number.
component.name: StatChip

component.description: Tab bar: a dark pill track with one button per tab and a gradient indicator that springs to the active tab ("IndicatorSlide"). Fires Changed(id) when the player picks another tab.
component.name: TabBar

component.description: Countdown pill ("1:59:30" or "1h 59m") with an optional clock icon. All timers share one ticker (Game/Ticker) that runs about four times a second only while a timer is counting.
component.name: Timer

component.description: Pill switch: green track when on, gray when off, white outlined knob that slides across. Mouse, touch and gamepad (A) toggle it.
component.name: Toggle

component.description: Tooltip: a small dark bubble that appears next to a target after a short delay and follows it while shown. It shows on pointer hover and on gamepad selection, and hides when either ends.
component.name: Tooltip

component.description: XP bar: a round level badge, an animated fill and optional "40/100" text. `bar:gain(amount)` plays the gain: the fill grows with a highlight flash, and a gain that overflows fills the bar, pops the badge, fires LevelUp(level), empties and carries on into the next level.
component.name: XPBar
